session, cohort, condition, fold, trial_idx, test_ordinal, joint, model (calib = the calibrated readout), r (held-out Pearson r of the final decoder output with the goniometer trace over the finite samples; empty = not computable, stored as NaN by the readout), rpt_r (= r), n_samples, first_finite_time_sec, scored

every reported accuracy is computed from the scored rows; e.g. the headline convention (a trial's r = mean over its six joints, a session's value = median over its scored trials, then the median over sessions) gives healthy IW 0.465586, healthy RW 0.883215, post_operative IW 0.538915, pre_operative IW 0.359230

random 10-fold cross-validation within each session; every trial is decoded once, by the model of the fold that holds it out; the same fold map serves the random 10-fold runs of a condition (the contiguous-fold control has its own folds)
